prior_importants.description: The skill says the conductor can run it, but its steps spawn project agents (review-conventions, review-spec, security-reviewer) and diff by `-C .worktrees/<task>` and a branch name. ADR 0118 says a conductor cannot load project agents and must not use either form for its review.

process_issues.description: The checkout is 591cb482, but the PR head was already ac2e7e09 when the review started. ac2e7e09 is not available locally, so reviewers were pointed at `gh pr diff 439` and reviewed the delta lines as they read at ac2e7e09 (lines 3, 9, 27, 54). I re-checked the head after they returned and it was unchanged. The prior important (the conductor could run the skill, against ADR 0118) is resolved at ac2e7e09: line 9 now limits the skill to the console.

Skipped correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety and maintainability: the delta is prose in one docs-only skill file, with no code logic, no workflow change and no new source. Skipped spec: there is no closing issue and no --spec.
